title: Dạ, chào anh
englishTitle: Respectful hello to an older man
summary: A respectful everyday greeting for a man who feels older than you, useful in cafés, taxis, shops, hotel desks, and help moments.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use Dạ, chào anh when greeting a man who seems older than you but not elderly. In many everyday moments, this sounds warmer than a plain Xin chào.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Dạ, chào anh. — Respectful hello to an older man.

phrases.english: Respectful hello to an older man

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Dạ -> polite opener | chào -> hello/greet | anh -> older brother / older man address

breakdown.english: Respectful hello to an older man

sections.title: Relationship words
sections.body: Vietnamese greetings often choose a relationship word. Anh is a safe everyday choice for a slightly older man.

sections.title: Relationship swaps
sections.body: Dạ, chào chị for an older woman. Dạ, chào chú for an uncle-age man. Dạ, chào ông for an elderly man.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use at the start of a taxi, shop, café, hotel, or help interaction when you want to be warm and respectful.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If age is unclear, keep your tone warm and use Dạ. The app should not punish uncertainty here.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Connect to: Chào anh, Dạ, chào chị, Cảm ơn, Do you speak English?
